test_PatchEmbeddings_forward: test PatchEmbeddings forward pass with conv projection and position embeddings on image inputs
test_PatchEmbeddings_masked: test PatchEmbeddings forward pass with image_patches_mask to zero out masked patch tokens
test_PatchEmbeddings_patch_drop: test PatchEmbeddings forward pass with patch_drop_rate to randomly drop patches during training
test_PatchEmbeddings_rectangle: test PatchEmbeddings forward pass with rectangular image_size tuple like (4, 6) and patch_size 2
test_PatchEmbeddings_no_cls: test PatchEmbeddings forward pass with include_cls_embed=False to skip the CLS token embedding
